kontaktformular.title: Contact and messages
kontaktformular.body: When you use the configured contact form, your name, email address and message are forwarded by email to handle your enquiry. Sending uses Resend and a function on Vercel. The legal basis, responsible parties, provider details and retention period will be added to the final privacy notice.

externe-dienste.body: Links to Google Maps open an external service. Original documents are provided by this website. Add details of all providers actually used before publication.
